justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: Heatmaps show position relative to gene start/end (numeric ticks such as -1000 to 1000 are visible on some panels) but no unit (bp or kb) is specified on the x-axis or in the caption for these heatmaps.

unit_definition_as_provided.definition: Distance around TADs is indicated in kilobases (shown as -3 kb and +3 kb in the figure and described in the caption).

justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: Genomic locus (rps19b) is shown along the x-axis but coordinate units (base pairs or kilobases) are not indicated on the axis or in the caption.
H3K9me3 signal intensity is plotted on the y-axis (track height with numeric ticks such as '800'), but the signal units or normalization (e.g., RPM, reads, fold enrichment) are not specified.
